standard_prerequisites.name: The base change behaviour of the derivation of the internal hom along a flat map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 3084-3086)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the duality quasi-isomorphism over the source into the corresponding quasi-isomorphism over the polynomial ring.

core_obligations: Injective dimension: the extension of scalars of the dualizing complex along the polynomial ring has finite injective dimension, by the behaviour of injective dimension under this extension and the finite dimension statement (proof lines 3074-3077)

Finiteness: flatness of the polynomial extension makes the cohomology modules of the extended complex the extensions of scalars of the cohomology modules of the original complex, hence finite (proof lines 3078-3080)

Duality: the structure sheaf of the polynomial ring maps quasi-isomorphically into the internal hom of the extended complex with itself, since formation of the internal hom commutes with flat base change in this case (proof lines 3081-3086)
proof_roadmap: 由 injective-dimension-over-polynomial-ring 与 More on Algebra 的有限内射维数引理 ⇒ ω_B^• 内射维数有限。
A → B 平坦 ⇒ H^i(ω_B^•) = H^i(ω_A^•) ⊗_A B 有限；且 B → RHom_B(ω_B^•, ω_B^•) 是拟同构（内射 hom 与平坦基变换可交换，base-change-RHom）⇒ ω_B^• 是 B 的对偶复形。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that tensoring a dualizing complex over a Noetherian ring with the polynomial ring in one variable over it gives a dualizing complex over that polynomial ring (author lemma at source lines 3066-3071, label lemma-dualizing-polynomial-ring). The proof (source lines 3073-3087) checks the three defining properties of the extended complex: finite injective dimension through the corresponding statement for the extension of scalars, finiteness of the cohomology modules through flatness of the extension, and the duality quasi-isomorphism through flat base change of the internal hom (proof lines 3074-3086). The verification of the three properties is the substance. H3.
